title: set_shared_variables request
description:
JSON payload of the `set_shared_variables` service request, found in `request.json_string.data` of the `urinterfaces/srv/SharedVariablesEditor` service.

Variables that do not exist are created, existing variables are assigned the new value. A variable set to null is deleted, which stops all running programs. The request is validated before anything is changed: if one value is invalid, no variable is modified. Other keys in the root object are ignored.

shared_variables.description: The variables to create, modify or delete, as `name: value` pairs.

Value.description: A variable value. Structs cannot be set through this service.

anyOf.description: Floating point number. A number with a decimal point or an exponent is stored as a float, other numbers as an int. A whole number outside the 32 bit range is therefore only accepted when it is written as a float (`3e9`), which this schema cannot tell apart from the integer `3000000000`, that is rejected.
A list, or a matrix when every element is an array.
Cartesian pose `[x, y, z, rx, ry, rz]`, position in meters and rotation vector in radians.

A list with a capacity. The capacity must not be smaller than the length of the list. A list whose elements are lists is handled as a matrix and its capacity must then be equal to its length, which this schema does not express.
